projects.name: Rollout SAP EWM May2022 to March 2025
details: Position Title: SAP EWM & MM Functional Consultant
• Involved in business meetings and part of information gathering team.
• Contacting the business users for requirements gathering to map into SAP environment..
• Define EWM warehouse structure and creation of bin structure.
• Define storage types and sections.
• Configuration of storage type search sequence.
• Configuration of warehouse process types.
• Configuration of put-away (Deconsolidation) and stock removal process through POSC.
• Configuration of packing specification.
• Configured Cross docking Process
• Configured Replenishment Cycle
• Configuration of Plant, Purchase Organization, Storage Location.
• Customization of the master records such as Material Master, Vendor Master, Source list
• Configuration of STO Process and configuration availability check procedure.
• Involved in cutover activities in maintaining material master and vendor master.
• Involved in initial stock upload of physical inventory.
• Involved in Unit Testing (UT)
• Completely involved in SIT & UAT
• Configuration of Release strategy, Release codes for Purchase Requisitions and Purchase Orders.
• Responsible for smart form changes related to Request for Quotations and Purchase Orders.
• Go Live and Hyper care support
• Provided end users with comprehensive training and handouts.

projects.name: EWM Implementation
details: Position Title: SAP EWM Functional Consultant
• Involved in business meeting and part of information gathering team.
• Attended workshops to gather business requirements and mapping the system as per the business requirement.
• Contacting the business users for requirements gathering.
• Basic system configuration. Defining and mapping the ECC & EWM warehouses.
• Define EWM warehouse structure and creation of bin structure.
• Define storage types and sections.
• Configuration of storage type search sequence.
• Configuration of warehouse process types.
• Configuration of put-away (Deconsolidation) and stock removal process through POSC.
• Configuration of packing specification.
• Quantity classification and Cross line put away
• Configuration of PPF and LOSC Process
• Involved in UT and SIT Testing
• Completely involved in UAT
• Cutover activities
• Go live and Hyper care support
HIGHEST QUALIFICATION
Master of Technology (M.Tech) in Machine Design from S.J.C. Institute of Technology, Visvesvaraya Technological
University (VTU).
